0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0, first in the Northwest and second in the West) are on a four-game winning streak, going 3-0 at home and 1-0 on the road, as they visit the Houston Rockets (5-0, first in the Southwest and first in the West), who are riding a five-game winning streak. The Thunder are without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee), while the Rockets are without Steven Adams (calf strain). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, following a 2025-26 series that the Thunder won 2-1, and their last meeting was a 112-106 Thunder loss in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
